title: Rafael and the Ledger
author: L. M. Nystrom
blurb: Gideon Kavanagh, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
